description: This file defines a final class 'HeaderProcessor' responsible for parsing HTTP headers in the Guzzle HTTP client library. It includes a static method 'parseHeaders' that extracts version, status code, reason phrase, and headers from an array of header lines.

classes.name: HeaderProcessor
classes.description: A final class with static utility method to parse HTTP headers.

methods.name: parseHeaders
methods.description: Parses an array of header lines to extract HTTP version, status code, reason phrase, and header fields. Throws exceptions if crucial parts are missing.
